page_title: NAN 1-0 REN | Nantes v Rennes 08/12/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+10' That's the end of the match.
90+9' Matthis Abline (Nantes) comes off the pitch to be replaced by Jean-Philippe Gbamin.
90+8' Here comes the VAR verdict. NO GOAL for Rennes due to a handball in the build-up play.
90+7' Wait! Referee Mickael Leleu has indicated he is going to review the Rennes goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was a handball in the build-up.
90+7' Referee halts the game and wanders over to the touchline to talk to Jorge Sampaoli, then promptly shows him a RED CARD!
90+6' Although Arnaud Kalimuendo (Rennes) is just on the bench, Mickael Leleu has awarded him with a yellow card. Unsporting behavior says the referee.

90+5' A perfectly taken corner kick. Christopher Wooh (Rennes) gets on the end of it and produces a fantastic bullet header from around the penalty spot into the middle of the net, increasing the score of today's match – 1:0.
90+4' The referee blows his whistle, Rennes are awarded a corner kick.
90' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.
89' 1 - 0 Moses Simon (Nantes) makes a great solo run and pulls the trigger from inside the box, beating Steve Mandanda with a strike into the right side of the goal. He makes it 1:0.
89' Jorge Sampaoli is forced to make a change. Arnaud Kalimuendo is unable to continue due to injury, Baptiste Santamaria (Rennes) comes on.
86' Shots on target – 1:3.
83' Moses Simon (Nantes) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
82' Jorge Sampaoli decides to make a substitution. Ludovic Blas will be replaced by Carlos Andres Gomez (Rennes).
80' The resulting set piece from Nantes is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
79' Nantes take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
75' That will be all from Nathan Zeze who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Sorba Thomas (Nantes).
73' Rennes seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
70' Jorge Sampaoli prepares a substitution. Jordan James is replaced by Christopher Wooh (Rennes).
68' The total number of attempts is 7:5.

65' Moses Simon (Nantes) received a pass inside the box and sent a dangerous shot in on goal, but keep the champagne on ice as one of the defenders stepped in and blocked the effort. It's hard to say whether the keeper would have stopped it.
63' Nathan Zeze (Nantes) commits a rough challenge and Mickael Leleu blows his whistle for an infringement.
61' Johann Lepenant (Nantes) is able to continue to play.
61' Johann Lepenant (Nantes) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
60' Johann Lepenant (Nantes) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
59' Mostafa Mohamed (Nantes) comes onto the pitch because Pedro Chirivella simply cannot continue any longer after picking up an injury.
58' Pedro Chirivella (Nantes) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
55' Mahamadou Nagida (Rennes) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box. The ball goes out of play and Nantes will have a goal kick.
54' The yellow card goes to Douglas Augusto (Nantes).

52' Nantes slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
49' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Rennes, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
47' Substitution. Jean-Philippe Gbamin (Nantes) replaces Matthis Abline.
46' Half-time substitution. Amine Gouiri is replaced by Mahamadou Nagida (Rennes).
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+11' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.

45+8' Douglas Augusto (Nantes) collects a sweet pass on the edge of the box and in one movement smashes a shot in on goal, but it balloons high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Rennes.
45+6' Nantes quickly take the free kick with a short pass.
45+6' Kelvin Amian (Nantes) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
45+5' Kelvin Amian (Nantes) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
45+4' Mikayil Faye (Rennes) takes out his opponent with a slide tackle and the referee wastes no time in showing him a red card!
45+3' Rennes take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

45+2' Great save! Amine Gouiri (Rennes) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the left side of the goal was brilliantly saved by Patrik Carlgren. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Rennes will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
45' There will be a minimum of 8 min. of added time.
45' Nantes failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
44' Nantes take the free kick with a short pass.
44' Hans Hateboer (Rennes) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Mickael Leleu blows his whistle for a foul. Free kick. Nantes will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
42' Moses Simon (Nantes) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared.
42' Mickael Leleu blows his whistle after Mikayil Faye (Rennes) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle. That's a free kick to Nantes.
40' Amine Gouiri (Rennes) strikes from the edge of the box, but hits it really poorly and sends the ball way over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Nantes.
38' Johann Lepenant (Nantes) attempts to convert a cross into a goal, but his promising header from near the penalty spot towards the roof of the net is denied by a decent save from Steve Mandanda.
36' Rennes have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
35' Lorenz Assignon (Rennes) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. Rennes will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
34' 49:51 – the ratio of ball possession.
32' Wonderful movement by Nantes. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.

30' Leo Ostigard (Rennes) timed his run perfectly to connect with the resulting corner kick, but his finish from around the penalty spot was rather poor as it went well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Nantes will have a goal kick.
30' Lorenz Assignon (Rennes) will deliver the corner kick.

26' Mikayil Faye (Rennes) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went towards the bottom right corner, but Patrik Carlgren was alert and the score remained the same.
25' Ludovic Blas (Rennes) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.
24' Douglas Augusto (Nantes) makes a run beyond the last defender, but he's offside.
23' Lorenz Assignon (Rennes) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
21' Pedro Chirivella (Nantes) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
19' Looks like Pedro Chirivella (Nantes) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
17' Eric Wattellier blows his whistle as Nicolas Cozza (Nantes) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
16' An injury to the match referee means he is going to have to be replaced by Mickael Leleu.
7' Arnaud Kalimuendo (Rennes) is caught offside, but it was a really close call.

6' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Nantes are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.

4' Lorenz Assignon (Rennes) latches on to a pin-point through ball, but one of the defending players dispossess him. Brilliant defending. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Rennes.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out at last! Nantes will take the kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Eric Wattellier.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
Show lineups
Good afternoon, ladies and gentlemen! Welcome to our live text commentary, where we will provide you with instant updates of everything that happens in the match.
